notes.title: Brainz... I MEAN - Breaking News!
notes.content:
Hey folks, we’re back with another Clodhoppers update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/7cf93dc6654a6e0b2ff3c7f25ac5627bd8743b44.png

Before we start, I should mention that some items shown may become premium only when the game leaves early access. 

If you want to experience everything Clodhoppers has to offer, for FREE - Now’s the time!

[hr][/hr]
K.O. KING IS NOW RUMBLE!

We’ve renamed K.O. King to Rumble and added 3 modes for players to choose from.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/ac00be6f91166475fcd8b93688f70c7287be9486.png

 Ding Mode - Each hit scores 1 point.
 Damage Mode - Damage inflicted scores points of equal amount.
 KO Mode - Each KO scores 1 point.

You’ll hear a DING! every time you score a point. The player with the most points win!

Man, do I love a good excuse for beating people up.

[hr][/hr]
CUSTOMISABLE BOMBS AND FLAGS

Next up on the menu are customisable bombs and flags!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/a29d8efb7e5248822c3a7921e5c28733fa2b753e.gif
 [code]Stickers (left) get recoloured to match your player colour in-game.[/code]
Players will be able to equip stickers (left) and wraps (right) however they see fit.

Visit the outhouse and navigate to the Extras menu to check them out.


 But that’s not all - Check out this next slide.

[hr][/hr]
NEW VOICES IN CLODHOPPERS!

Ahem - Allow me to introduce you to Maude and.. Zombie?

[previewyoutube=IL4iXnb8Lqo;full][/previewyoutube]

Maude is the first female voice in Clodhoppers - It was about time, wasn’t it? 

There’ll be more to come haha, don’t worry.

Also, please welcome zombies and skeletons! The zombie voice is um.. quite lovely, isn't it?

Anyways, I’ve been asked not to pay the zombies too much attention. We don’t want any bad news at the studio - What’s that noise..?

[hr][/hr]
 VARIOUS LEVEL CHANGES

The events of the last two weeks have been chaotic. The zombies will soon break through our defences - I truly fear for our safety..

But on the bright side! Mal’s been cooking some changes to various levels - Yippee!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/a55d91be0cc1c120a1f924ff8d12f546ade1c3b2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/3ae6fa4af4ff702ab9d8fdf857c65fafdcf7511b.png

Check it out - Pit 2 and Pit 3 have undergone a complete redesign.

For Pit 3, we’ve introduced a new interactable object - The target! 

The target functions similar to the lever, however, it can also be triggered by projectiles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/1767c05155e628fa640de04390a1c166ad22b9f0.png

We’ve added trampolines to Bounce House and Burping Burt!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/caf3e25576f67a931ef37c83f6caf3f47e7ecca3.png

While Burping Burt is excellent chaos, the trampolines really add flavour into the mix. 

It feels like a boxing ring, with the trampolines throwing you back into the action whenever you’re misfortunate enough to have been knocked off.

While they can sometimes save you from death, you can still fall off the edge mind you.

https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5be5a25f85ede16e553b18e7/7c781148-b1f0-4766-aa24-8f0376b82973/PinchWallBlog2CropSteam.gif?format=750w

Beta testers will remember when we had the rising wall on Pinch.
We’ve bought that back! Truly a great pick for Team Knock Out.

Last but not least, we’ve completely remade the Online Lobby - What do you think?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/473624944cf696cbf2731c1ce12b7d69c4ade58b.png

There’s been some smaller changes made to other levels as well. Let us know if you spot them!

Awesome work, Mal! Now, can we please bring back Wide? I’m missing it more every day..

[hr][/hr]
MISCELLANEOUS


 Added an option to allow controller 1 to be used for a 2nd player.
 Improved performance and added configurable graphics options.
(Anti-aliasing in a work in progress)
 Added a new zoom mode which frames the entire level in view.
(Zoom is Z on Keyboard, RS on Controller)
 Added an option to allow players to respawn after falling.
(Subtracts 1 health point - Subject to change)
 Various UI changes, improvements and bug fixes.
 Various improvements to player movement.
 Added new emote animations.
 Improved gameplay camera.
 Added hints for assistance.
 Improved director mode.
 Improved voice chat.

★ Hundreds of other general bug fixes.

[hr][/hr]
CLOSING REMARKS

For those unaware, we make regular updates to our beta build. 

If you’re interested in experiencing the latest that Clodhoppers has to offer, as well as joining us for weekly play tests - Join our Discord Server to participate!

Huh, Mal's got a weird vibe about him.. Is that a bite mark?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/e6b2b13d708e6f0bb58ad39731cc40e50cfb7d97.png

Keep in mind that things are subject to change - We’re still making the game!
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀   
That’s all we’ve got to share for now, until next time.

notes.title: A Lot to Unpackage
notes.content:
Howdy folks, we’re dropping a bombshell of an update today! 

While the public build of Clodhoppers has been stable for a while, our beta branch has been bubbling with updates that we’re finally ready to push forward - But first, behold our new trailer!

[previewyoutube=f-bLyAeePDc;full][/previewyoutube]
Awesome work on the Trailer, Anthony! We wanted to share an up-to-date look at Clodhoppers since the old trailer was so outdated. I’ll go over the most prominent changes below.

[hr][/hr]
THE EMOTE WHEEL

We’ve made HUGE changes to our emote system. Introducing… *Drum roll please* The Emote Wheel! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/d61fb3cced39e61bc1402ed874adaf7a57bb0221.gif

Players can now equip up to 7 emotes on a customisable wheel, further allowing you to tailor your experience.

But don’t worry, the D-Pad/Number Keys isn’t going anywhere! It still remains an option for quick-access taunting. Nice job team.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/f720a1f377225e834c591dd1da757dd69c7cdc81.gif

Press RS (controller) or C (keyboard) to bring up the emote wheel - Give it a spin!

Along with these changes, we’ve also made it easier to swap character personalities. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/2e8c1c15de5e63987e3a9790eeca852fd49dbe09.png

Previously, if you wanted to change your character’s personality, you needed to choose from a preset - erasing your design entirely. Now, it’s as easy as choosing from a list. 

Want to sing some holiday tunes as Santa, or rant about conspiracies as Wingnut? Fret no longer :)

[hr][/hr]
ACCESSORIES GALORE!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/fcf109d2a6c5e13c3b888c0911f5ea57800fb1f6.png

Mal and Anthony have been hard at work tailoring some new Clodhoppers fashion - What do you think?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/58c629153d5612af4d0e81f32435ab004dd52d3c.png

In addition to new accessories, shoes are now customisable! Previously, unique shoes were restricted to entire outfit changes - But where’s the fun in that? Check out these sick kicks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/fb7b98cedbeb0c813f55b2c5efd0aa3347a06737.png

The additions don’t stop there though - We’ve got awesome new neckwear, as well as new player heads. Hopefully they capture that charm of yours ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/69c51c76b4f814fd581c47fd820f5a657244bdcc.png

Last but not least are prints and tattoos - Show off your energy with some sweet clothing and body ink.

There’s a few other new accessories that I haven’t mentioned, see if you can spot them in-game!

[hr][/hr]
A Change of Scenery

Face punching is an excellent past time, but how about a change of scenery? Since our last update, we’ve added four new maps to Clodhoppers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/ab370ae17ee940652c75fcb9fc94129cc46a6c32.png

Heh, well.. Plateau isn’t a new map, but the changes are so LARGE it might as well be considered one!

What do you think? Unfortunately, Wide will be taking a break from the map pool. It was great fun, but we need to revise the design before we feel it’s ready to return :)

[hr][/hr]
MISCELLANEOUS


 Typing /radio in the online lobby now broadcasts messages
 Bomb explosions now show explosion radius
 Rolling now breaks falls from certain heights
 Team game now allows for uneven teams and custom kits


[hr][/hr]
CLOSING REMARKS

What do you think? Feel free to let us know! 

Keep in mind that this is all a work in progress. Changes are likely to occur often as we revise the game’s design and features following development.

Huge thanks to everyone who’s been joining play tests these last few months;

_sirJames, Murrax, Orandza, Greetings, neoNote, Ottomantech, Excalibur Heavy Battlecruiser, Unit Delta, Donny Kurniawan - and everyone else who has paid Clodhoppers a visit!

Thanks for reading, and thanks for playing Clodhoppers :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/932ce419538ea2b7566b8f8e44c68e12565d66eb.png

notes.title: Version 3490 is here!
notes.content:
Version 3490

We have made lots of improvements over the last two and a bit months (over 200 of them!) Here are some highlights:
- Many bug fixes and gameplay tweaks
- New UI and UX polish
- Dozens of new cosmetics and character items
- 3 new levels and multiple changes to existing ones to improve flow and fightability!
- New voice sets
- Basically a bit more of everything

As this is still an early access build there are bugs and known issues that we'll be tackling over the months to come. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: New and improved! Clodhoppers version 3208
notes.content:
Hello all! This is a massively updated version of Clodhoppers that features character customisation, a new lobby system and much much more. We've been hard at work on this for a long time and although we've been updating the beta build regularly we're excited to release this to everyone! Since it's that time of year, you might spot some festive additions too!

Character customisation
- New characters!
- Experiment with the default characters to find your favourite voices!
- Detailed outfit and accessory selection - tweak 'til your heart's content!
- Mix and match styles and change the colours on nearly everything!

Playable lobby
- Start offline right by your shack, have friends join in for some couch-based gameplay or...
- Head online to join a lobby and play with friends (or friends to be) from around the world!

A huge update months in the making
- 100s of level updates
- Many bug fixes
- Weapon and gameplay tweaks
- New HUD and UI overall

Please note! This is still an early work-in-progress game and as such there are plenty of bugs and known issues. In the new year we're going to continue to add new features and polish everything up into a bright sheen.

Many thanks for checking it out and we hope to see you online!

- The Claymatic Team

notes.title: Version 0.2693 is live!
notes.content:
Lots of minor tweaks and quality of life improvements. Plus! Lots of background work preparing the game for our updated character customisation!


 New conspiracy-nut characters and voice set
 Level collision improvements, fixes and polishing (spot the water splashes!)
 Username is pulled from Steam now
 Various gameplay improvements
 Updated networking model for starting games making it more robust to client dropouts
 Can no longer die in the tutorial level :)
 Improved character collision detection making it more robust
 Prevented countdown spamming
 Under-the-hood preparations for our improved character customisation

notes.title: New version released: 0.2576
notes.content:
Version 0.2576 highlights

 Includes global lobby and room chat so you can talk to friends whilst waiting
 New UI layout and level art
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/5695ef507bb9313688cb60ff2fd85f374d1d2e84.jpg
 Updated visuals including this new hand-made stop-motion explosion!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902112/80fc6652ec5afb2acf5cbd3ac52cf637db1e8a54.jpg
 Many bug fixes and balancing tweaks

Details:

 Fixed pass-through bugs letting you climb out of the level
 Bombs and other pickups have less time to glance a platform before hitting a player and still doing damage
 KO player bomb drops have been rebalanced and timings adjusted depending on the number of KO'd players
 Spawn points are slightly jittered to prevent crazy bomb stacking
 Players can no longer join a full room
 Dialog popup and handling of network disconnects (this is an initial solution, in future we'll try rejoining the current game automatically)
 You can now jump whilst aiming with the mouse (!)
 Ticker log correctly identifies melee weapons
 Fixed broken portrait UI
 Fixed players not dying properly in the tractor level
 Fixed tutorial sprite icons
 Changed character selection method to use shoulder buttons/bumpers
 New rare [REDACTED] weapon
 Rooms now have a status badge making it easier to see when a game is ready to start or in progress
 New UI skin and more consistent input (still WIP)
 Lobby and room chat API additions
 Optimised input traffic by 3x
 Rooms can only exist once unless full, making it easier for one person to start a game
 New built-in room "Brawl Central" with randomised level selection that scales with the number of players
 Better death handling when falling off the tractor


We hope you enjoy!

notes.content:

- Some more work on the experimental levels

Enjoy!
